PURPOSE: Deterministically derive CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 from a complete snapshot-bound canonical finding universe while separating product-only P0 findings and failing closed on any ambiguity.

SUPERSEDES_CANDIDATE.NOTE: V1 remains durable history. V2 is not canonical until independent review accepts it.

SNAPSHOT_BINDING.RULE: Every projection input and evidence record MUST resolve inside one pinned control commit/tree or be content-addressed by immutable blob/hash explicitly bound into that snapshot. Mixed-snapshot projection is invalid.

RAW_NORMALIZATION.finding_id: Must be a non-empty JSON string already equal to NFC(value), with no leading/trailing Unicode whitespace. Case is preserved and comparisons are case-sensitive.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.finding_path: Canonical repository path using '/' separators; no '.', '..', duplicate '/', leading '/', or trailing '/'; path string must equal NFC(value).
RAW_NORMALIZATION.severity_raw: Preserve source value exactly. For classification, value must be a non-empty NFC JSON string with no leading/trailing whitespace; otherwise p0_classification=UNKNOWN.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.status_raw: Preserve source value exactly. Terminal comparison is allowed only when value is a non-empty NFC JSON string with no leading/trailing whitespace; otherwise terminal_nonblocking=false and status_valid=false.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.type_raw: Preserve exact source spelling. Missing or malformed type never independently proves PRODUCT_ONLY or CONTROL_BLOCKER.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.null_rule: Missing, null, empty, malformed, or conflicting authority-bearing values never receive permissive normalization; they become UNKNOWN/invalid as specified below.
RAW_NORMALIZATION.byte_order: UTF-8 byte ordering after NFC normalization.

P0_CLASSIFICATION.NON_P0_RULE: A well-formed severity_raw not present in EXACT_VARIANT_MAP is NOT_P0 only when a canonical severity taxonomy artifact bound by blob SHA explicitly classifies that exact value below P0.
P0_CLASSIFICATION.UNKNOWN_RULE: Any unrecognized, missing, malformed, conflicting, or untaxonomized severity is UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN makes PROJECTION_STATUS=UNKNOWN_BLOCKING and OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT=null.
P0_CLASSIFICATION.FREE_TEXT_RULE: Free-text mentions of P0 outside authoritative structured severity never establish P0 class.

STATUS_CLASSIFICATION.terminal_nonblocking_rule: terminal_nonblocking=true only for exact case-sensitive equality with one of TERMINAL_NONBLOCKING_EXACT after validation above, unless a separately versioned canonical status taxonomy explicitly defines another exact terminal non-blocking value and its blob SHA is bound into this schema generation.
STATUS_CLASSIFICATION.fail_closed_rule: All other values, including null, missing, ACKNOWLEDGED, AUTHORITY_CORRECTION, REPRODUCED, RESOLVED_* variants, OPEN_* variants and unknown strings are blocking for an otherwise eligible control-P0 row.

RULES.CONTROL_BLOCKER: Requires a VALID classification record proving the finding affects admission, target/law/spec authority, control integrity, gates, leases, integration authority, closure authority, canonical roots, resource/shard authority, control transport, or other preactivation control correctness.
RULES.PRODUCT_ONLY: Requires a VALID classification record proving resolution is normal product implementation and the finding does not independently affect activation/control authority.
RULES.SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE: Requires both a VALID classification record and VALID dedup decision record binding this finding to one canonical blocker.
RULES.HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING: Requires exact terminal_nonblocking=true plus a VALID classification record establishing historical/noncurrent control relevance. Age alone is insufficient.
RULES.UNKNOWN: Used whenever evidence is absent, stale, conflicted, malformed, self-certified where independent review is required, or otherwise insufficient.

CONTROL_RELEVANCE.UNKNOWN_P0_RULE: If p0_classification=P0 and control_relevance=UNKNOWN, projection fails closed with OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT=null.

EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.source_path: normalized repository path or pinned-spec logical identifier
EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.source_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA for repository evidence; exact pinned spec SHA-256 for AUTHORITATIVE_SPEC_REFERENCE
EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.json_pointer_or_anchor: non-empty NFC string locating the evidence within source
EVIDENCE_REF_OBJECT.statement_sha256: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of UTF8(NFC(canonical evidence statement))

VALIDITY_RULES: finding_id/path/blob must exactly match the pinned finding-universe row.
independent reviewer must differ from classifier_chat_id.
independent review must bind classification_record_id, record_generation, finding_blob_sha, control_relevance and exact evidence hashes, with verdict PASS.
If multiple highest-generation valid records disagree, classification is UNKNOWN.
A lower-generation record is superseded only by a strictly higher valid record for the same finding_id.
supporting and canonical blocker findings must both exist exactly once in the complete pinned finding universe.
independent reviewer must differ from classifier_chat_id and review the exact decision generation/content.
Dedup chains are forbidden. canonical_blocker_id must resolve to a non-SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE row.
Cycles, missing parent, conflicting highest-generation decisions, blob mismatch, or stale evidence make dedup validity UNKNOWN and projection fail closed.

INPUT_MANIFESTS.FINDING_UNIVERSE: Must PASS NEXY_V16_RC1_3_CANONICAL_FINDING_UNIVERSE_CONTRACT_V1 completeness at the same pinned snapshot.

CLASSIFICATION_MANIFEST.ROW_SORT: finding_id UTF-8 bytes, then record_generation ascending, then classification_record_id UTF-8 bytes

DEDUP_DECISION_MANIFEST.ROW_SORT: supporting_finding_id UTF-8 bytes, then record_generation ascending, then dedup_decision_id UTF-8 bytes

ROW_TYPES.severity_raw: source value preserved exactly or null
ROW_TYPES.status_raw: source value preserved exactly or null

PROJECTED_MANIFEST.ROW_INCLUSION: Emit one row for every finding-universe finding whose p0_classification is P0 or UNKNOWN. NOT_P0 rows remain in the source universe but not in this projected manifest.
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.DEDUP_KEY_RULE: For a valid SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE row dedup_key=canonical_blocker_id; otherwise dedup_key=finding_id.
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.SORT: dedup_key UTF-8 bytes, finding_id UTF-8 bytes, finding_path UTF-8 bytes.
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.DUPLICATE_ROW_RULE: More than one universe row for the same finding_id is already a universe completeness failure. Multiple projected rows may share dedup_key only through independently reviewed valid SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE decisions.
UNKNOWN_BLOCKING_TRIGGERS: classification record conflict or invalidity for any P0 row requiring semantic classification
PROJECTED_MANIFEST.HASH_RULE: CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH = SHA-256(UTF8(JCS(ROOT_OBJECT))) only when projection_status=VALID. When UNKNOWN_BLOCKING, CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH is null for activation authority.

COUNTING.OPEN_BLOCKER_ROW_RULE: A projected row is open-control-P0 iff p0_classification=P0, control_relevance=CONTROL_BLOCKER, and terminal_nonblocking=false.
COUNTING.SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE_RULE: A valid SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE row never increments count independently; its dedup_key resolves to the canonical blocker, whose status controls the blocker count.
COUNTING.HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING_RULE: HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING is admissible only with terminal_nonblocking=true; otherwise classification record is invalid and projection becomes UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.
COUNTING.PRODUCT_ONLY_RULE: PRODUCT_ONLY P0 rows are excluded from OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT but remain durable in finding/product requirement accounting.
COUNTING.OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT: When projection_status=VALID, count unique dedup_key values among open-control-P0 canonical blocker rows. Otherwise null, never zero.
COUNTING.ZERO_PROOF: OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0 is provable only when projection_status=VALID, source universe completeness PASS, all required classifications/dedup decisions PASS independent review, and the computed count is exactly 0.

FAIL_CLOSED: Partial search or partial shard coverage never proves zero.
Resolved-like status prefixes never become terminal automatically.
Severity-only inclusion never decides control relevance.
Product-only classification without independent review is UNKNOWN.
Duplicate mapping without independently reviewed exact evidence is UNKNOWN.
Any stale or mixed-snapshot evidence makes projection UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.
No status/finding may be mass-closed or mass-superseded merely to reduce the count.
